actor: open-model RL post-training research group, independent of AMD and the vime core team
job: Reproduce and benchmark end-to-end open-model RL post-training on AMD Instinct MI355X to de-risk a second, non-NVIDIA hardware vendor.
outcome: A published, reproducible end-to-end open-model RL post-training run on AMD Instinct, independent of AMD and the vime team.
motivation: Escape CUDA-only post-training, secure cheaper and available compute for the most compute-hungry phase, and gain hardware-vendor leverage.

task.what: run and benchmark open-model RL post-training on MI355X
task.where: rented or owned AMD Instinct clusters via vime plus ROCm Docker
task.why: escape CUDA-only post-training; cut cost and vendor lock-in
task.how: vime framework plus prebuilt ROCm Docker container on MI355X

actor: AMD Instinct ROCm AI-software and developer-relations team
job: Harden the ROCm RL post-training path, launch MI450, and seed Instinct access so external labs can reproduce vime runs.
outcome: A production-grade, documented ROCm and vime path plus available MI355X/MI450 capacity that external groups adopt and publish on.
motivation: Establish AMD Instinct as the credible second vendor for RL post-training and break NVIDIA's CUDA lock on the highest-value phase.

task.who: AMD's ROCm software and Instinct developer-relations engineers

motivation: Diversify compute suppliers, secure capacity for the compute-hungry RL phase, and cut dependence on scarce NVIDIA GPUs.
